metric: mean AUROC within the 8 strata (finding x current state), seed-averaged p_yes
interval: 95 %, SE_tot^2 = SE_boot^2 + Var(per-seed contrasts)/n_seeds; bootstrap within the 16 cells, B = 2000, seed 0
P2: on validation: S-none >= 0.60 and S-none minus S-none-qswap >= 0.05
G1: S-own minus S-swap: interval above 0 and every per-seed contrast above 0
G2: S-own minus S-none >= tau, interval above 0, every per-seed contrast above 0, and L = (S-own - S-swap) - 2/3 (S-own - S-none) >= 0
G3: 5-fold cross-validated logistic stack per finding (folds stratified by cell, current state as covariate) of T-history plus logit(S-own), minus T-history alone: bootstrap interval above 0
